question: What is the worst-case time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements?
explanation: Each comparison halves the search range, so at most $\lceil \log_2 (n+1) \rceil$ comparisons are needed: $O(\log n)$.

question: Which data structure does a program use to manage function calls, including recursion?
explanation: Each call pushes a frame (parameters, local variables, return address) onto the call stack, and returning pops it. Last call in, first out.
